wiki_text: Sinopec's Longkou (Yantai Longkou) LNG terminal Phase 1 (6.5 mtpa / 650 wan-tonne design throughput; one ~150,000-266,000 m3 LNG berth retrofitted from existing Longkou Port bulk berths; 4x220,000 m3 tanks) had its four storage tanks pass acceptance inspection by early January 2025, with the receiving-station main works reported fully built and mechanically complete by mid-2025, targeting commissioning readiness in 2025. Independent reporting in late 2024/early 2025 still describes the project as under construction.
verification_status: [CORROBORATED — 2+ INDEPENDENT NON-GEM SOURCES; near-term commissioning date is single-source]

wiki_text: PipeChina's (National Pipeline Group) Longkou Nanshan LNG terminal — the group's first major energy infrastructure project (3 phases, ~20 mtpa total; Phase 1 = 5 mtpa, 6x220,000 m3 tanks, one 266,000 m3 berth) — passed intermediate handover with all six Phase-1 storage tanks and the receiving-station main works fully built by early January 2025, and is in final works/commissioning toward a single-shot startup. Mechanical/electrical installation (seawater pumps, BOG compressors) had progressed through late 2023.
